title: Open Food Log v0: saved meal
description: A meal a person keeps to log again ("my usual breakfast"): a name and items shaped like meal items. Logging it makes a new meal whose items are counted again, from the foods as they are then (section 8). v0.2; may change until v1.

id.description: namespace:slug. saved: is one person's saved meal, meaningful only inside the system that made it.

name.description: What the person calls it; a sentence naming it logs it.

meal_type.description: The meal type to log it as when the person names none.

label.description: A free label, as on a meal.

items.description: What it holds, each like a meal item: the person's words, the food and the amount. grams and nutrients, where present, are what the item counted when it was saved; logging counts again.

estimates.description: JSON pointers to values inferred or assumed rather than given, as in a meal. An item whose amount is listed is logged with its amount marked estimated.
